mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz.wcs_eqp_pallet_m (eqp_pallet_id, status, location, updated_at) VALUES (#{eqpPalletId}, #{status}, #{location}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (eqp_pallet_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, location = EXCLUDED.location, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
